name: Latency, cost and conversation capability boundaries v2 (EN)
description: Public synthetic benchmark: direct reply, bounded reads, Task admission with known or unknown means, historical refusal, mixed outcomes, verified prohibition, human choice and Process priority. Effect-free fixtures; no production transport, queue or real Task execution.

items.content: The return period for the fictional Orbe product is 17 days after receipt.

tool_catalog.name: conversation_task_submit
tool_catalog.description: Admit substantial work after comparing it with the recent Tasks shown in context. A renewed request is not automatically a retry of a failed Task. Prefer CREATE_NEW with the recorded failure, useful partial results and corrections in the framing hints. Use conversation_task_retry only for a deliberate retry of the same work. Choose AMEND_CURRENT or AMEND_QUEUED only when the same primary artifact or target keeps substantially the same success criteria. Choose CREATE_NEW for a different target, repository, resource, deliverable, or independently verifiable outcome, even when it shares the same document or incident. Sharing a destination is not enough to amend: if either outcome can be completed without the other, create a new Task and leave existing work unchanged. Amendments require target_task_id and expected_revision. While delegated children are active, an accepted amendment is queued durably for the leader's next synthesis: the receipt has deferred=true and applied_at=null. Contributions keep running; do not edit source documents or send a peer message as a substitute for this instruction. An unavailable amendment returns without creating another Task: re-read the target and reconsider the amendment; use CREATE_NEW for an independent outcome. Use REPLACE only for an explicit replacement: its successor waits for confirmed stop of target_task_id at expected_revision. Unresolved coordination returns a conflict. The supplied label and objective are framing hints: before creating a new Task, Galaris rebuilds both with the agent's standard model from the complete conversation context, memory, URLs, and resource references. Use mode=plan only when explicitly requested; omitted controls remain the dispatcher's decision. This tool never chooses Task effort; the dispatcher owns that decision. Explicit deterministic chat directives such as @high use the separate direct-admission path. Ask the user when the relationship is ambiguous. Return immediately and never expose the canonical Task URI unless explicitly asked.

tool_catalog.name: conversation_task_status
tool_catalog.description: Read one Task's durable phase, plan progress, last error and bounded result. Use this before describing what the agent is currently doing.

tool_catalog.name: conversation_process_start
tool_catalog.description: Start an assigned business Process asynchronously, associate it with this conversation, and return its internal tracking ID for later Process tools. Never wait for completion or expose that ID to the user unless explicitly asked. The server freezes the workflows and exact inputs requested by the actual current message before the first new launch. A reply to an activity does not authorize a new run. Retries reuse the same invocation. input uses ordinary JSON values, including a canonical URI string for a File. Use typed_values=true only when every value uses an explicit {type, value} envelope. Use conversation_process_prepare to collect every selected input, searching known facts/files first and asking only for missing ones. An incomplete call returns a preparation dossier and its WAITING run. Complete inputs release that same run. When all inputs are already known or defaulted, call this tool directly; no separate preparation call is needed. For a ready dossier, omit input: the server reuses its typed values without loss or resubmission. Use occurrence=2 only when THIS SAME human message requests two identical executions; a single 'relaunch it' in a new message uses occurrence=1 and resolves its workflow/values from actual history.
